rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice when something ends up in another form, state, or use, including a deliberate change of purpose.

example.english: They convert the old bus stop into a café.
example.traditional: 佢哋將舊巴士站變成咖啡店。
example.jyutping: keoi5 dei6 zoeng1 gau6 baa1 si2 zaam6 bin3 sing4 gaa3 fe1 dim3

rows.note: Use this specifically for exchanging one currency or thing of equal value for another.

example.english: I need to convert five hundred dollars into Japanese yen at the airport.
example.traditional: 我要喺機場兌換五百蚊做日圓。
example.jyutping: ngo5 jiu3 hai2 gei1 coeng4 deoi6 wun6 ng5 baak3 man1 zou6 jat6 jyun4

rows.note: Use this for expressing a quantity in different units or an equivalent numerical form.

example.english: You can convert one mile into 1.6 kilometres.
example.traditional: 一英里換算做一點六公里。
example.jyutping: jat1 jing1 lei5 wun6 syun3 zou6 jat1 dim2 luk6 gung1 lei5

rows.note: Use this construction when causing someone to convert to a particular religion, faith, or belief.

example.english: The pastor led him to convert to Christianity.
example.traditional: 個牧師令佢改信基督教。
example.jyutping: go3 muk6 si1 ling6 keoi5 goi2 seon3 gei1 duk1 gaau3
